graph.title: LEGO 7268-1 Crab
notes: Booklet thumbnails are small; placements are best-effort estimates, restructured so every piece is joined by stud contact.

Hinge legs: each black 1-finger hinge plate (p19-p24) is placed on the studs of a red 2-finger hinge root (p25-p30), finger pointing outward; hinge joins are also listed in other_joins. Interleaved finger overlap was removed because it was flagged as a collision.
Dark grey hinges p31/p32 sit under the black 4x4 base (studs into its underside) at the back as the grey legs.
Red wedges p17/p18 sit side by side as the roof on the orange/grey plates; items on the wedges sit on their inner stud columns (cols 1-2) since the outer columns have no studs.
One model only; no separate sub-models, so the single connected group is correct.

graph_initial.title: LEGO 7268-1 Crab
notes: Booklet is small and low-detail; placements are best-effort estimates from the thumbnails.
Six red 2-finger hinges form the leg roots on the black 4x4 base; six black 1-finger hinges are the upper legs; the two grey hinges extend two back legs.
Wedge plates, antenna levers, side-handle plate and the orange/red sub-assembly (booklet step 8 inset) placement is approximate.
Steps counted through the booklet: steps 1-7, inset sub-assembly steps 8-10 combined loosely, final step 11.

final_issue_list: the build is 5 separate groups of pieces; connect them unless the booklet really builds separate models
p10 (lego-3023) rests on 3 pieces but has only 2 stud cells underneath
p15 (Plate 4 x 4) and p32 (Hinge Plate 1 x 2 Locking with 1 Finger on Side, with Groove) fill the same space: check their column, row, layer and turn
p15 rests on p32, but their placements do not join them: its bottom is at layer 1 but the top of p32 is at layer 1.68095
p2 rests on p7, but their placements do not join them: they share no stud cell (check column, row and turn)
p3 rests on p7, but their placements do not join them: they share no stud cell (check column, row and turn)
p12 rests on p1, but their placements do not join them: its bottom is at layer 8 but the top of p1 is at layer 8.5
